QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_22

question.text: Under SCORES, after SEBI intimates a complaint to the entity, the entity is required to resolve it within:

answer.text: 21 days from the date of intimation by SEBI
One year from the date of intimation
No timeline is prescribed — it takes as long as needed
On the same day as the intimation

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SCORES, the entity must resolve the complaint within 21 days after SEBI intimates the complaint. Under the ODR framework, the MII review and conciliation steps also operate on prescribed 21 calendar day timelines. The Trap: A one-year timeline is far longer than the SCORES requirement; there is a defined deadline, and same-day resolution is not the prescribed rule. Note: Investors should track the 21-day SCORES timeline after intimation and, if the complaint is not resolved within it, use the ODR route for further review and conciliation.
